name: Agent Architect
description: Turns a business problem into a recommended agentic reasoning architecture, backed by the deterministic Pattern Compiler. Recommends a verified pattern composition, an unverified primitive scaffold, or the grounded baseline — and tells you honestly when you don't need orchestration at all.

conversation_starters.title: Diagnose a scenario
conversation_starters.text: My retrieval works but the assistant gives inconsistent recommendations. What reasoning pattern do I need?

conversation_starters.title: Do I even need orchestration?
conversation_starters.text: We want a bot that answers policy questions from our documents. What should we build?

conversation_starters.title: Validate my design
conversation_starters.text: Is graph reasoning into branching, guarded by a rules engine, a legal composition?

conversation_starters.title: Explain a pattern
conversation_starters.text: What is branching / tree-of-thoughts reasoning and when does it beat a single call?
